name: Asaptic
description: Asaptic is the AI that wins and fulfills cross-border trade deals: it reads a tender or RFQ, clears cross-market compliance, sources and vets suppliers, prices to win, and drives the deal to a signed, fulfilled contract. It also publishes a free public cross-market tender listing feed for people and their AI agents. A separate Physical AI & robotics lane operates at asaptic.com/physicalai.

datasets.name: Public tender listing feed
datasets.description: Free, keyless cross-market government/public-body tender listing feed: sanitized trilingual summaries (en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant) with bucketed metadata across 7 markets. Rows are non-actionable by design; the actionable technical tier (spec-coded packages) requires an approved account.
datasets.usage: GET /api/v1/tenders with filters (market, category, closing_bucket, q, lang, limit, cursor). Cite with attribution; do not redistribute as a competing dataset; do not attempt to map listing ids to underlying notices. Access to gated technical data: request_tender_access or engage@asaptic.com.
datasets.provenance: Compiled and sanitized by Asaptic; refreshed continuously; listing rows are summaries, not official notices.

datasets.name: Cross-Standard
datasets.description: Public-interest, source-linked compliance comparisons: China GB standards vs destination-market requirements across product categories and export markets. AI-compiled, informational, trilingual (en/zh-Hans/zh-Hant).
datasets.usage: Fetch index.json for the full list of {slug, product, market, rows, json, page}; fetch exports/{slug}.json for the structured rows (requirement, target_requirement, china_equivalent, gap, mandatory_status, verdict, source) of one comparison. Cite with attribution; verify against the cited official regulator before relying on it.
datasets.provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-verified, not human-verified; informational only — not legal/certification/market-access advice.

crossings.label: × post-quantum security
crossings.summary: Asaptic is the AI that wins and fulfills cross-border trade deals: reading tenders and RFQs, clearing cross-market compliance, sourcing and vetting suppliers, pricing to win, and driving deals to signed, fulfilled contracts.

crossings.label: × hardware
crossings.summary: Embodied agents cannot undo a physical action. There is no rollback in the physical world. This single constraint separates hardware-grounded AI from every other application domain. Asaptic works on the accountability architecture for agents whose decisions leave physical traces: audit trails, override logs, constraint embeddings, and the governance layer that regulators and operators can actually inspect.

crossings.label: × physical-world human care
crossings.summary: Regulated care — eldercare, clinical support, rehabilitation — is the hardest crossing. Consent, dignity, and liability are not software abstractions here; they are enforceable obligations attached to real people in real rooms. Asaptic works on the accountability and safety layer for agents that operate in care environments.
